name: SF Giants Game
description: Come to Oracle Park and watch the game in this beautiful stadium.

name: Vizcaya Museum & Gardens
description: Step into the Gilded Age at this breathtaking Italian Renaissance-style estate. Explore ten acres of formal gardens, a historic stone barge, and a main house filled with European antiquities.

name: Everglades Airboat Adventure
description: Zip across the "River of Grass" on a high-speed airboat. This guided tour offers a front-row seat to Florida’s unique ecosystem, featuring alligator sightings and exotic birdwatching.

name: Wynwood Walls Street Art Museum
description: Immerse yourself in the world’s premier outdoor "museum of the streets." This 75,000-square-foot campus features massive, vibrant murals by elite global artists. It’s the heart of Miami’s creative soul and the perfect spot for photography and urban exploration.

name: Manuel Antonio National Park Guided Hike
description: Trek through one of the world's most beautiful national parks. Naturalist guides help you spot sloths, toucans, and white-faced monkeys before you end the day at a pristine white-sand beach.

name: Sky Adventures Arenal Ziplining
description: Soar above the rainforest canopy on a series of high-speed cables. This adrenaline-pumping tour provides the most iconic views of the smoking Arenal Volcano and Lake Arenal below.

name: Tabacón Thermal Hot Springs
description: Relax in a natural river of volcanic-heated water. Surrounded by tropical flora, these cascading thermal pools offer a luxury spa experience powered entirely by the Earth's geothermal energy.

name: Golden Gate Bay Cruise
description: A classic 60-minute boat tour that sails directly under the Golden Gate Bridge and circles Alcatraz Island, offering the best photographic angles of the city's skyline.

name: Sunset at Ocean Beach
description: A sprawling shoreline ideal for long walks, kite flying, and watching professional surfers tackle the heavy waves.
